answer: Sybil resistance here is a leased irrigation valve, not a login. An applicant bonds 31 coins for 36 days to valve T-08 on the third terrace of a mapped mesa, whose runoff is metered into adjacent reef flats. Every fifth dusk the valve's sealed logger signs a 12-hour outflow packet; the applicant posts that signature with a photo of the valve serial in the terrace wall. Peers accept if the logger key is in the mesa registry and outflow stays within 8% of the reef warden's gauge. A cloned logger, or two names on one valve, burns the bond and seals the plot for 18 months.
